_about: Medals for the Career tab (R37). Earned once each (the count of times is kept too) from things the game already tracks. Stored in the career profile (user://voidsworn_career.json); they never change campaign or battle rules. glyph is a single character drawn inside the medal's crest; col its colour.

medals.d: Win a battle in 3 rounds or fewer.
Win a battle with only one of your ships still fighting.
Clear a whole sector without losing a ship.
Capture 3 enemy ships in one run.
Destroy your Nemesis's flagship in his last fight.
Win a run with Heat on.
Destroy 100 enemy ships across your career.
Win a run with every faction.
